title: SEC Structured Filings — Allocator & Sponsor Mapper

secUserAgent.title: SEC User-Agent (required)
secUserAgent.description: The SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent with a real contact email on every automated request. Format: "Company Name email@domain.com". Runs without this will fail.

sources.title: Sources to pull
sources.description: Form D = private-offering sponsors and their related persons (EDGAR). Form ADV = registered and exempt reporting advisers (SEC monthly bulk report).

enumTitles: Form ADV — RIAs & exempt reporting advisers

formDMode.title: Form D discovery mode
formDMode.description: daily_index sweeps every Form D filed in the lookback window (complete, filtered structurally — use this for the scheduled run). full_text searches EDGAR full-text for thesis keywords (cheap and targeted). quarterly loads SEC bulk data sets (use once, for backfill).

lookbackDays.title: Lookback days
lookbackDays.description: How far back to look. 30 suits a weekly scheduled run; full-text mode tolerates 365+.

fullTextQueries.title: Full-text queries
fullTextQueries.description: Only used in full_text mode. Each phrase is searched as an exact phrase across Form D filings.

quarters.title: Quarters to backfill
quarters.description: Only used in quarterly mode. Format: 2026q1, 2025q4, ...

includeAmendments.title: Include Form D/A amendments
includeAmendments.description: Amendments often carry the updated amount-sold figure, which is the strongest signal that a sponsor is actively raising.

industryGroups.title: Form D industry groups to keep
industryGroups.description: Form D's own industryGroupType values. Leave at the default to keep real-asset and pooled-fund filings and drop everything else.

maxOfferingAmount.title: Maximum total offering amount ($)
maxOfferingAmount.description: Screens out mega-institutional raises. Filings that report an indefinite offering (the $100B sentinel) are never dropped by this rule. 0 disables it.

requirePooledFund.title: Only pooled investment funds
requirePooledFund.description: Narrows Form D to fund vehicles rather than single-asset deals.

advMinRaum.title: Minimum RAUM ($)
advMinRaum.description: Floor on regulatory assets under management. 100000000 keeps advisers big enough to write a real check.

advMaxRaum.title: Maximum RAUM ($)
advMaxRaum.description: Ceiling that screens out mega-institutional advisers who will not look at a fund this size. 0 disables it.

advMaxRows.title: Max ADV rows to read per feed

minSectorFitScore.title: Minimum sector-fit score
minSectorFitScore.description: Records score positive on MHC / storage / industrial / IOS / 1031 language and negative on multifamily-only, farmland, venture, crypto and similar. 0 keeps anything not actively against the thesis.

excludeFirmNames.title: Firms already in the database
excludeFirmNames.description: Paste your existing investor list here to suppress duplicates. Matching is on a normalized name, so "Acme Capital, LLC" and "ACME CAPITAL" collapse to one.

keepExcludedForReview.title: Keep excluded records, flagged
keepExcludedForReview.description: Instead of dropping records that fail the exclusion or score rules, emit them with excluded_reason populated so you can audit what the filters are throwing away.
